_README: Accepted exceptions for the static gate (Gate 9). EVERY entry must carry a reason.
A waiver without a stated reason is a lie told to the next person who reads the report.
Waivers are for 'we looked, and this is correct as-is' - never for 'this is noisy'.
Prefer fixing. If a finding recurs and is genuinely fine, waive it HERE with the why.

_routes_why.Account/Register: DEF-332, waived 2026-08-04 on Shawn's decision. Self-service sign-up is a DESIGNED PHASE 2 FEATURE, deliberately not wired up for Phase 1. Views/Account/SignUp.cshtml posts to an Account/Register action that does not exist yet - that is unbuilt, not broken. Waived so a known-future feature does not block every deploy. RE-CHECK AT PHASE 2 KICK-OFF: when Register is built, DELETE this waiver so the gate resumes guarding the route. See also the deadcode waivers for the four sign-up views.
